weights: Official original GEN1 checkpoint; no retraining or checkpoint selection
tile_policy: Four fixed overlapping views; no GT crops. Tile boxes clipped to their native crop; global classwise NMS across all tile anchors.
anchors: Unchanged pixel anchors of the 256-trained checkpoint; 512 is resolution transfer, not retrained high-resolution detector
clock_and_population: Exact prior complete-window grid after 10 warmup queries; unchanged native-area small subset and original onset
limitations: 512 changes effective anchor scale; tiling changes context and border policy
Annotation-time fresh detection endpoint, not wall-clock completion deadline
Calibration FPPI is not guaranteed equal on other sequences
No allocation criterion hypotheses are adjudicated here
